name: cortex_update_memory
description: Update an existing memory's title, content, or tags. Re-generates the embedding if content or title changes. Use this for memory maintenance: fixing errors, improving descriptions, or updating tags.

memory_id.description: ID of the memory to update

title.description: New title (if omitted, title is unchanged)

content.description: New content (if omitted, content is unchanged)

tags.description: New tags (replaces existing tags; if omitted, tags are unchanged)
